comments.author: gxxx-hum
comments.body:
> How about the performance before?

This PR focuses on fixing the BNSD limitation encountered by customvoice under concurrency levels higher than 4 after enabling the codec_chunk_ramp feature. We resolve this issue by falling back from BNSD to BSND.

With this improvement, streaming scenarios can be effectively adopted in production environments. The following results show the performance without enabling codec_chunk_ramp. As shown below, the Streaming continuity OK rate for a single request has already dropped to 0.
